about_the_game:
Experience the essence of deckbuilding. Figure out a fun build from a unique set of cards and carefully evolve your deck into a well-oiled war machine. Are you a combo clown or a face hunter? Do you like big decks?

Achieving strategic superiority is the second part of the mission. Map your opening moves, navigate the fog of war and cleverly outmaneuver the enemy. But stay sharp.. getting tank rushed is what happens when you are busy making other plans.

Engage in tense 10-minute tug-of-wars on a level playing field. Go head to head with a meticulously balanced pool of cards. Don’t copy decks, build on-the-fly and let your creativity shine. Every match is a new mind game! Beat the player, not the meta.

In this skill game you have a fair shot at the top spot, no matter the size of your collection. Climb the ranks fighting with weapons of equal strength. There is no pay-to-win.

Embark on a journey into the depths of powerful card combos and commanding strategies. Play, analyze, think deep, experience glorious lightbulb moments, discover unknown synergies, test, adapt and outplay to pull off truly epic wins!

Join the ranks of veterans who keep coming back for more, even after hundreds of hours. Just one... more... game... Playing is believing!

Features

Innovative mechanics

• Interactive map instead of a life total

• Unique draw system

• Intricate hidden information dynamics

• Disrupt to counter key card combos

Ever-growing card pool

• 50 base set cards

• Frequent release of new expansion packs

• 4 card expansion packs available at launch

Medal system

• Influence the card pool used in a match

• Play with your favorite cards more often

• Collect medals and create your twist on the game

Made for PvP

• Ranked & casual modes

• PvP leaderboard

• Play a friend

• Mirrored shop mode

• Relaxed, normal and blitz game speeds

Chill in PvE

• Bootcamp missions

• Specialized AI bots (easy, normal, hard, unfair)

• Challenge runs: 7 win mini-tournaments

• Pause mid-game & resume later

Progression

• Rank up from bronze to diamond - and beyond

• Collectable avatars & player titles

• Unlockable card expansion packs in the future

Analyze and Show Off

• Hyperlink replay sharing & spectator invites

• Observe live high-ranked matches

• Weekly show matches

• Get your crazy wins featured!

reviews:
“Tuggowar is a great competitive deckbuilder, I really love it. If you dig Prismata then you'd probably like it.”
- Elyot Grant, creator of Prismata
short_description: Tuggowar is the big-brain deckbuilding duel. Engage in tense combat on a solarpunk frontier. Assemble your deck turn by turn, discover powerful card combos, disrupt the enemy strategy, and pilot your well-oiled war machine to victory!
